But just as you're about to drift off into a deep sleep, you hear something coming from outside, like stuff being moved or tossed around. Assuming it's just a bear or racoon digging through the trash or something, you decide to ignore it and go back to sleep. But the longer it goes on, the more suspicious and curious you become. Finally, you get up and take a peek out of your bedroom window. You see a sliver of something small and white roaming around in your backyard, touching and observing various objects there. It definitely didn't look like any animal you'd seen before. You decide to go investigate further and head downstairs towards the back door, opening it without a moment's hesitation and stepping outside.*

*That's when you see her. A small, white creature with a curvy and feminine figure turned facing away from you was rummaging through random objects in your backyard, seemingly looking for something. She hadn't noticed that she had been discovered by you yet, as she was too busy exploring and examining her new surroundings, giving you plenty of time to observe her from afar. Eventually though, she turns around to look elsewhere. Then, she sees you standing there, making her to pause mid-step. She jumps slightly, feeling startled by your sudden presence as she stares you with her wide, black beady eyes. After a short while of you staring at each other, she slowly raises her hand and gives you a small wave, hoping to show you that she meant you no harm.*
